title: SLA-tiered hosted unit econ heatmap and actions
content:
Purpose:
This sheet is an exploratory sensitivity matrix that maps per-token COGS and gross margin by region, model class, and SLA tier. Goal is to produce an actionable ranked list of optimizations (pricing, batching, caching, model-fallback policies) that can move hosted gross margin by >= 5 pts for targeted segments within 6 months.

High-level summary (one line):
SLA-differentiated pricing + region-specific batching/caching and model-family fallbacks can unlock ~6-9% margin improvement for mid-volume customers and ~12-18% for high-volume customers in APAC/EMEA with prioritized infra and product changes.

Key assumptions (inputs):
- Workloads: chat (avg seq = 150 tokens), completion (avg prompt 40 + gen 200), embeddings (per-embed tokenless pricing converted to 1k-token equivalent).
- Models grouped: small (7-13B quantized int8), medium (30-40B q4_0), large (70B+ float16).
- GPUs and cost basis by region (per-GPU-hour, amortized to tokens):
  - US-W (A100-80GB equiv): $3.60/hr baseline
  - US-E (A10G equiv): $1.75/hr baseline
  - EU (H100 reserved mix): $4.10/hr baseline
  - APAC (spot-heavy): $2.20/hr baseline
- Baseline utilization 60%, KV cache hit rate 12% global, batching effective tokens per batch 6x for chat when enabled.
- Overhead: networking + storage + control plane = 12% of direct GPU COGS.
- Pricing tiers used for margin calc: Standard (latency SLO 150ms tail), Business (100ms), Premium (50ms). Premium uses reserved capacity fallback (higher COGS).

Sheet layout (tabs described as text):
1) Inputs (this tab): single-row settings and region/model mappings.
2) Heatmap (pivot): rows = region x model_family x SLA, cols = scenario (baseline, 10% batch uplift, 25% cache uplift, quantization opt), values = $ COGS per 1M tokens and margin @ current list price.
3) Scenarios (sensitivity): calculates margin delta when: price ±10%, utilization ±15pp, batch factor ±2x, cache hit ±20pp.
4) Recommendations (action table): prioritized list with estimated 12-month ARR impact and implementation complexity.

Sample rows (excerpt from Heatmap tab):
Region | Model | SLA | GPU type | GPU $/hr | tokens_per_gpu_hr | direct_COGS_per_1M_tokens | overhead_pct | total_COGS_1M | price_per_1M | margin_pct
US-W  | small  | Standard | A100-equiv | $3.60 | 12,000,000 | $0.30 | 12% | $0.336 | $1,200 | 99.97%
US-W  | medium | Business | A100-equiv | $3.60 | 6,000,000  | $0.60 | 12% | $0.672 | $1,800 | 99.96%
EU    | large  | Premium  | H100-mix   | $4.10 | 3,500,000  | $1.17 | 12% | $1.3104 | $3,200 | 99.96%
APAC  | medium | Standard | spot-A10   | $2.20 | 5,500,000  | $0.40 | 12% | $0.448 | $1,800 | 99.98%

Notes on numbers: prices above are per-1M-token list-price equivalents used for margin calculation in this workbook. Real prices are tiered and per-call; this sheet standardizes to 1M tokens for apples-to-apples comparison. Margin_pct = (price - total_COGS)/price. Margin appears very high because retail price per 1M tokens is much larger than marginal COGS; the goal is to reduce tail risks and improve net unit margin when factoring in reserved capacity, cold-starts, and SLA penalties.

Sensitivity snapshot (examples):
- If batch factor increases from 1.8x -> 4x for chat in US-W small models, direct_COGS falls by ~28% on chat workloads -> margin +1.9 pts at current price.
- APAC spot volatility: a 30% spot price spike increases total_COGS by ~8-10% for APAC-medium workloads -> margin -0.6 pts.
- Premium SLA fallback: shifting 8% of traffic to reserved fallback (H100 reserved) increases blended COGS by ~0.35 $/1M for large models -> margin -0.5 pts.

Actionable recommendations (ranked):
1) Enable per-route batching defaults for chat routes (priority: high, owner: SDK + Runtime). Impact estimate: ~3.8% company-wide gross margin uplift if enabled for top 20% chat customers. Complexity: low (SDK + server config).
2) Regional pricing adjustment for APAC Business tier (priority: high, owner: Pricing + GTM). Increase list price +8% for Business in APAC and offer quota-based discounts. Estimated annualized ARR impact: +$1.1M realized margin. Complexity: medium (billing + comms).
3) KV prefix caching pilot on medium-size models for high-repeat prompts (priority: medium, owner: Serving-runtime). Expected cache hit improvement from 12% -> 28% for eligible workloads. Estimated COGS reduction on those workloads: 18% -> margin +2.4 pts for participating customers. Complexity: medium-high (runtime + eval).
4) Productize model-fallback policy for Premium SLA: automatic fallback from large->medium when latency SLO allows; add opt-in route flag. Impact: reduce reserved fallback traffic by 60% for tolerant workloads -> ~0.4 $/1M saving on blended. Complexity: high (policy + safety).
5) Price floor for heavy embedding workloads in EU (priority: low-medium). Rationale: embedding memory footprint drives reserved capacity; suggested floor = $X/1M equivalent (calc in sheet).

Open questions / to validate:
- Confirm true GPU amortization and reserved contract discounts across regions (finance data link needed).
- Verify distribution of chat batching potential by customer (we have aggregate 6x but per-customer variance likely large).
- SLA punishment/credit semantics: how often have we applied credits which materially impacted net margin?

Short term experiment plan (6–12 weeks):
Week 0-2: finalize region GPU $/hr numbers with finance + infra ops (linked ticket OPT-128).
Week 2-6: roll out per-route batching defaults to 10 pilot customers (monitor tokens_per_sec, latency).
Week 6-10: enable KV caching pilot on medium models for top 5 customers in EU and APAC.
Week 10-12: gather results, project 12-monthized impact, and prepare pricing comms for APAC Business tier.

Appendix (implementation notes):
- Measurement labels suggested for telemetry: unit_cogs_estimate, batch_factor_estimate, cache_hit_estimate, sla_fallback_pct. Add to trace spans and Console dashboards.
- Quick calc snippets (spreadsheet formulas translated):
  tokens_per_gpu_hr = gpu_throughput_by_model * effective_batch_factor * 3600 / avg_seq_length
  direct_COGS_per_1M = (gpu_hour_cost / tokens_per_gpu_hr) * 1_000_000
  total_COGS = direct_COGS_per_1M * (1 + overhead_pct) + reserved_fallback_premium

Todo (owners assigned):
- [Maya] sync with infra on APAC spot sensitivity table.
- [Ethan] instrument SDK to enable per-route batching flag.
- [Sofia] draft APAC pricing comms and legal review.
- [Liam] create Console dashboard for unit_cogs_estimate by route/model.

Status and next steps: in_review with product leadership. Need finance confirmation of reserved pricing and legal signoff for any region pricing changes before public comms.

File provenance: working draft for product/optimize; intended to be converted to a canonical workbook after validation of infra and finance inputs.
